entities.summary: Olivia Saar was an Estonian children's writer and poet, and a journalist and editor associated with major Estonian children's periodicals. She worked for decades on the children's magazine Pioneer and was among the founders of the magazine Täheke. Olivia Saar was a authors & novelists from Narva (1931-10-18, Narva–2025-03-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
